newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Netanyahu denies decision on economic plan.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Netanyahu denies decision on economic plan.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's spokesman denied on Sunday an Israeli newspaper report that Netanyahu had decided on a comprehensive economic plan to revitalise the country's sluggish economy.

Yedioth Ahronoth newspaper said Netanyahu had reached a decision on a programme to widen the Israeli shekel's trading bands, liberalise foreign currency controls, set lower interest rate targets and enact further cuts in the 1997 budget.
"The Prime Minister has not yet decided on the issue. The details of this decision have not been finally set," the spokesman Shai Bazak said in a statement.

The newspaper said an economic programme had been under discussion for weeks but deep disagreements between Finance Minister Dan Meridor Netanyahu and Bank of Israel Governor Jacob Frenkel had prevented any decision.
The report said Netanyahu had stepped in to break the deadlock.
